methodologyNotes: Published self-serve subscription pricing was collected for each consumer video-streaming provider as of the accessed date, with each figure corroborated against a dedicated 2026 pricing-review source where the official pricing page geolocated outside the USA (showed EUR), rendered plans behind a JavaScript plan picker, or omitted standalone tiers. All prices are flat per-account per-month in USD (annual rates recorded as annualDiscountPct where the provider publishes one); these are consumer subscriptions, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null throughout. Add-on/extra-member rates (e.g. Netflix extra member, Prime Video Ultra) are noted in plan notes; no quote-only consumer tiers exist in this vertical.
